title: mapping
description: The format of web/src/modules/mappings/mappings.yaml, Veda's file: a list of rules 'when [signal] happens in [mode], do [control], [this way]'. Guide: docs/commands-guide.md. The engine skips an invalid rule and shows a friendly error in the Command Lab, so a typo never breaks the app. Extra keys are allowed so Veda can add her own knobs.

when.description: A signal id from the signal catalog.

do.description: A control id from the control catalog.

range.description: How far the control can move.

min_confidence.description: How sure the app must be before acting.

hold_ms.description: Only fire after the moment has been held this long (for example a sign held 2000 ms); progress shows while holding.

only_while.description: Arming signal: the rule only works while this is active.

value.description: Fixed value to set when a trigger fires.
